thread:
marta_cs: Hey team — quick day0 ops checklist for Novus (private VPC). Need final confirm before tomorrow's dry-run: 1) Egress NAT + firewall rules, 2) Cross-account IAM role for observability, 3) KMS CMK access & rotation plan (BYOK?), 4) Audit logs -> customer SIEM (s3/forwarder), 5) certs for internal endpoints. Ping owners.

sam_se: Can you paste the CIDRs and required ports? Also do we need static egress IPs or is SNAT ephemeral okay for this customer?

leo_cloudops: We recommend static egress for Novus (they're pinning allow-lists). Request 3 IPs for HA. Our peering CIDRs -> 10.40.0.0/16 and 10.41.0.0/16. Required ports: 443 outbound to customer endpoints; 22 only via bastion. Example SG snippet: 
```
Type: HTTPS
Protocol: TCP
Port: 443
CIDR: 0.0.0.0/0 (outbound)
```

anya_security: For KMS: customer prefers BYOK. Need sample key policy showing cross-account access and kms:ViaService if they route requests via a service. Rotation should be enabled (annual). Also confirm CloudTrail -> their SIEM subscription; we should ship management events and data events for S3. Retention ask? compliance wants 90 days.

jordan_pm: Heads-up: Novus contract ties go-live to week2 SLA. If networking slips and dry-run is missed, renewal negotiation could be impacted. Escalate any blockers ASAP.

deploybot: Ticket #CS-7892 updated: status "Waiting on customer to confirm firewall ALLOW list" — due 2026-04-01.

marta_cs: I'll chase Novus POC (yakov). @sam_se can you post the static egress IP allocation by EOD? @leo_cloudops can you drop the NAT gateway template link and any helm values for envoy egress?

sam_se: :thumbsup: allocating now, will post IPs in this thread when done.

leo_cloudops: Template link: https://internal.redwood/templates/nat-ha — helm values for envoy egress (small snippet):
```yaml
egress:
  staticIPs: ["198.51.100.10", "198.51.100.11", "198.51.100.12"]
```

anya_security: Also require audit log retention = 90 days for their compliance audit. Legal confirmed SOW can include this? @marta_cs

marta_cs: Customer signed addendum for 90d retention. I'll attach the scanned addendum to CS-7892.

sam_se: Posted IPs: 198.51.100.10/32, 198.51.100.11/32, 198.51.100.12/32. Firewall ops notified (ticket NET-445).

leo_cloudops: IAM role trust example for observability cross-account: 
```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [{
    "Effect": "Allow",
    "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/Redwood-Observability"},
    "Action": "sts:AssumeRole",
    "Condition": {"StringEquals": {"aws:SourceVpc": "vpc-0a1b2c3d"}}
  }]
}
```

jordan_pm: Great — can someone capture a concise go/no-go checklist (3–5 items) we can attach to the runbook? I'll need it for the exec sync.

marta_cs: Proposed quick checklist: 
- network reachability (client <-> endpoints) confirmed
- IAM cross-account assumeRole validated
- KMS key present + correct key policy (BYOK validated)
- audit logs visible in SIEM (sample events)
- smoke gen+embed calls within baseline latency (<200ms)
I'll run the smoke at 2026-03-24 09:00 PT.

sam_se: I'll be on stand-by for NAT failover and to confirm IPs. Ping me in thread when you start.

deploybot: Reminder scheduled: smoke-test run at 2026-03-24T09:00:00Z — results will post to this thread.

marta_cs: Thanks all — I'll post final runbook link and attach CS-7892 docs. If anything else comes up before EOD, drop it here and I'll triage.
